name: Clerk Auth (managed)
description: Drop-in user authentication with email, OAuth, and social logins. Hosted sign-in pages and pre-built React components.

requiredSecrets.name: CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
requiredSecrets.reason: Used by the frontend Clerk provider

requiredSecrets.name: CLERK_SECRET_KEY
requiredSecrets.reason: Used by the backend to verify session JWTs

postInstallNotes:
1. Mount `clerkMiddleware()` before your protected routes in Express.
2. Wrap your React tree with `<ClerkProviderWrapper>` and place `<AuthHeader />` in your navbar.
3. Add `VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` to the frontend env (same value as `CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY`).
